package_name: Manali Hidden Circuit (4D) — Bijli Mahadev, Jana Falls & Raison

itinerary.day_1: Manali Orientation (Drive: Local). Places: Hadimba Temple, Vashisht Hot Springs, Old Manali. Activities: Hadimba Temple; Vashisht hot springs; Old Manali village walk.
itinerary.day_2: Bijli Mahadev Trek (Drive: 14 km + trek). Places: Bijli Mahadev. Activities: Drive to Chansari; 3km trek (2,460m); Kullu valley panorama.
itinerary.day_3: Jana Waterfall & Naggar (Drive: 30 km). Places: Jana Waterfall, Naggar Castle. Activities: Jana Waterfall trail; Naggar Castle heritage; Nicholas Roerich Gallery.
itinerary.day_4: Solang & Depart (Drive: 15 km). Places: Solang Valley, Rohtang Pass. Activities: Solang Valley adventure; Rohtang Pass view; Afternoon depart.
